pairs.caption: Elevated view over the Calico buildings toward the tilted rock ridge and the valley beyond. Old: black-and-white print (photographed lying on gravel, rotated 90 degrees in the original file). New: colour photo from the ghost-town overlook.
pairs.alignment_method: Deep feature matching (LoFTR, multi-scale) on the print crop vs the modern photo, RANSAC similarity transform (uniform scale + rotation + shift, ~0.3 deg rotation); print cropped and perspective-rectified by a 4-point homography and rotated upright.
pairs.alignment_note: Ridge line, rock layers and main buildings coincide in the overlay; ~65% of matched features within 8 px (1600 px wide). Slight ghosting on near-field buildings/trees (vegetation and building changes, small viewpoint offset).

pairs.caption: Overlook with a dark foreground rock outcrop with a small natural opening at its top on the left, buildings below, and the wide valley and distant mountains beyond. Old: black-and-white print (rotated 90 degrees in the original file). New: colour photo from the ghost-town overlook.
pairs.alignment_method: LoFTR multi-scale matching + RANSAC similarity transform (~4 deg rotation, ~0.8x zoom crop); print cropped and rectified by 4-point homography.
pairs.alignment_note: Foreground rock outcrop, horizon and mountain ridges line up (median match error ~3 px at 1600 px wide); nearby foreground and the buildings are offset by a few pixels because the camera positions differ slightly (parallax), and the building changes are real changes.

pairs.caption: Long low building with signs against a rocky hillside, with a wooden headframe behind it. Old: black-and-white print (rotated 90 degrees in the original file) showing the building with signs reading MAGGIE MINING Co., GLORY TUNNEL and COMMISSARY, two ore carts and a man standing at the right. New: colour photo of the Maggie Mine building with its current sign, rail track and fence.
pairs.alignment_method: LoFTR multi-scale matching + RANSAC similarity transform (~-1.7 deg rotation, ~1.09x zoom); print cropped and rectified by 4-point homography. Note: the man in the old print is a historical figure, not a modern person.
pairs.alignment_note: Roofline, headframe and hillside coincide; ~58% of matched features within 8 px. Some doubling on foreground track/fence (different camera position/height) and the different sign/paint.

pairs.caption: Looking down a small wash between hills toward the flat valley floor and a distant flat-topped hill, with a large hillside of steeply tilted rock layers on the right. Old: black-and-white print. New: colour photo from the top of a wooden walkway, with a lamp pole and wooden walkway not present in the print.
pairs.alignment_method: LoFTR multi-scale matching + RANSAC similarity transform (~1.3 deg rotation, ~0.59x scale of the modern frame, i.e. the modern photo is a wider view so only a central crop is used); print cropped by 4-point homography. Common area is cropped so both outputs are identical size.
pairs.alignment_note: Tilted rock layers, ridge and distant hill coincide (~1200 RANSAC inliers). Median match error is ~10 px at 1600 px wide, and the near field (walkway, pole) does not exist in the print. Alternative candidates IMG_2994 and IMG_2999/3001 also match but with fewer inliers (IMG_3002 chosen for having the best inlier count).

pairs.caption: Old print of a small cluster of low buildings with vehicles parked on a flat clearing, beside a large hillside of tilted rock layers on the right, with a flat valley floor and distant mountains behind. New: colour photo of what appears to be the same hillside and valley view, with the buildings absent and a wooden walkway in the foreground.
pairs.alignment_method: LoFTR multi-scale matching + RANSAC similarity transform (~2-4 deg rotation, ~0.35-0.38x scale, so only a cropped region of the modern photo is used); only a partial overlap (~0.53 of the print area) is common to both frames, and the print is cropped to that area. Few reliable matches (~100 inliers).
pairs.alignment_note: Only the tilted rock layers and general hill silhouette correspond; the buildings in the print are gone, foreground differs, and the modern view is from a different (higher/more distant) position, so ghosting is visible on the valley floor/horizon (median feature error ~22 px at 1600 px wide). Best of several tested candidates (IMG_2994, 2999, 3001, 3002, 3004-3008), but the match is not confident; do not rely on it without visual confirmation.
